de.name: Edinburgh Castle
de.text: Das Edinburgh Castle thront auf dem Castle Rock. Es beherbergt die schottischen Kronjuwelen und den Stone of Destiny seit dem 12. Jahrhundert.

de.name: Royal Mile
de.text: Die historische Hauptstraße der Altstadt verbindet das Schloss mit dem Palace of Holyroodhouse und ist gesäumt von engen mittelalterlichen Gassen.

de.name: Palace of Holyroodhouse
de.text: Die offizielle Residenz des britischen Monarchen in Schottland wurde im 16. Jahrhundert erbaut und liegt am Fuße der Royal Mile.

de.name: St Giles' Cathedral
de.text: Die im 12. Jahrhundert gegründete Kirche ist das geistliche Herz von Edinburgh und beeindruckt durch ihren markanten kronenförmigen Turmhelm.

de.name: Arthur's Seat
de.text: Der 251 Meter hohe erloschene Vulkan im Holyrood Park bietet einen spektakulären Panoramablick über die gesamte Stadt und die Küste.

de.name: National Museum of Scotland
de.text: Das Museum präsentiert umfangreiche Sammlungen zur schottischen Geschichte, Natur und Technik in einem prächtigen viktorianischen Gebäude.

de.name: Scott Monument
de.text: Das 61 Meter hohe viktorianisch-gotische Denkmal zu Ehren des Schriftstellers Sir Walter Scott prägt das Stadtbild in den Princes Street Gardens.

de.name: Calton Hill
de.text: Ein Hügel im Stadtzentrum, auf dem sich mehrere Nationaldenkmäler befinden, darunter das unvollendete National Monument und das Dugald Stewart Monument.

de.name: Princes Street Gardens
de.text: Diese öffentliche Parkanlage trennt die Altstadt von der Neustadt und bietet einen malerischen Blick auf das Schloss und die Skyline.

de.name: Royal Yacht Britannia
de.text: Die ehemalige Staatsyacht von Königin Elisabeth II. liegt heute als schwimmendes Museum im Hafenviertel Leith vor Anker.

de.name: Talbot Rice Gallery
de.text: Die Galerie für zeitgenössische Kunst der Universität von Edinburgh.

de.name: Writers' Museum
de.text: Ein Museum, das dem Leben und Werk berühmter schottischer Schriftsteller wie Robert Burns und Walter Scott gewidmet ist.

de.name: Dynamic Earth
de.text: Ein Wissenschaftszentrum und Museum in Edinburgh mit interaktiven Exponaten zur Geschichte und geologischen Entstehung der Erde.

de.name: National War Museum
de.text: Ein Museum im Edinburgh Castle, das die schottische Militärgeschichte vom 17. Jahrhundert bis zur Gegenwart zeigt.

de.name: The King's Gallery
de.text: Eine Kunstgalerie im Palace of Holyroodhouse, in der Werke aus der königlichen Sammlung ausgestellt werden.

de.name: St Cecilia's Hall
de.text: Ein historischer Konzertsaal und Museum in Edinburgh, das eine der weltweit bedeutendsten Sammlungen von Musikinstrumenten beherbergt.

de.name: The People's Story Museum
de.text: Ein Museum in Edinburgh, das die Geschichte der Arbeiterklasse der Stadt vom späten 18. Jahrhundert bis heute erzählt.

de.name: Trinity House
de.text: Ein historisches Schifffahrtsmuseum in Leith, das einst der Hauptsitz des Trinity House of Leith war.

de.name: Royal Scottish Academy
de.text: Eine renommierte Kunstinstitution und Galerie in Edinburgh, die zeitgenössische schottische Kunst und Architektur fördert.

de.name: Modern Two
de.text: Ein Zweig der Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art mit hochklassigen Ausstellungen moderner und zeitgenössischer Kunst.

de.name: RBGE Inverleith House

de.name: Fruitmarket
de.text: Eine Galerie für zeitgenössische Kunst im Zentrum von Edinburgh, bekannt für ihre innovativen Ausstellungen und ihr Engagement für neue Kunst.

de.name: Scottish National Portrait Gallery
de.text: Eine Galerie in Edinburgh, die Porträts von Personen gewidmet ist, die die schottische Geschichte und Kultur geprägt haben.

de.name: Melville's Monument
de.text: Ein großes Säulendenkmal auf dem St Andrew Square, das Henry Dundas, dem 1. Viscount Melville, gewidmet ist.

de.name: St Bernard's Well

de.name: Traverse Theatre

de.name: Leith Theatre

de.name: Pleasance Theatre

de.name: Reid Concert Hall

de.name: Gordon Aikman Lecture Theatre

de.name: Festival Theatre

de.name: King's Theatre
de.text: Ein historisches edwardianisches Theater in Edinburgh, bekannt für seine traditionellen Varietés und Pantomimen.

de.name: The Hub
de.text: Ein markantes gotisches Gebäude, das als zentrales Zentrum für das Edinburgh International Festival und andere Veranstaltungen dient.

de.name: Assembly Rooms

de.name: Duddingston Kirk
de.text: Eine alte Pfarrkirche im Dorf Duddingston, deren Teile bis ins 12. Jahrhundert zurückreichen.

de.name: Edinburgh Central Mosque
de.text: Die Hauptmoschee von Edinburgh, die der muslimischen Gemeinde der Stadt Gebets- und Bildungsstätten bietet.

de.name: Augustine United Church
de.text: Eine bedeutende United Reformed Church im Zentrum von Edinburgh, bekannt für ihre neogotische Architektur.

de.name: Charlotte Chapel

de.name: Mayfield Salisbury Parish Church

de.name: Church of St John the Evangelist

de.name: The Parish Church of St Cuthbert

de.name: Bruntsfield Links

ro.name: Castelul Edinburgh
ro.text: Castelul Edinburgh domină orașul de pe Castle Rock. Adăpostește bijuteriile coroanei scoțiene și Piatra Destinului încă din secolul al XII-lea.

ro.name: Royal Mile
ro.text: Succesiunea de străzi care formează artera principală a Orașului Vechi, legând Castelul Edinburgh de Palatul Holyroodhouse prin curți medievale.

ro.name: Palatul Holyroodhouse
ro.text: Reședința oficială a monarhului britanic în Scoția, acest palat din secolul al XVI-lea este situat la capătul de jos al traseului Royal Mile.

ro.name: Catedrala St Giles
ro.text: Fondată în secolul al XII-lea, această biserică este inima spirituală a orașului, fiind recunoscută după turla sa unică în formă de coroană.

ro.name: Arthur's Seat
ro.text: Vârful unui vulcan stins situat în Holyrood Park, oferind o panoramă spectaculoasă asupra capitalei scoțiene de la 251 de metri înălțime.

ro.name: Muzeul Național al Scoției

ro.text: Stânca vulcanică pe care se află Castelul Edinburgh, formând o parte dramatică a topografiei orașului.

ro.name: Bruntsfield Links
ro.text: O zonă de parc deschisă din Edinburgh, populară pentru recreere și găzduind unul dintre cele mai vechi terenuri de golf din lume.

en.name: Edinburgh Castle
en.text: The historic fortress dominates the skyline from Castle Rock, housing the Honours of Scotland and the Stone of Destiny since the 12th century.

en.name: Royal Mile
en.text: A succession of streets forming the main thoroughfare of the Old Town, connecting Edinburgh Castle with Holyrood Palace through medieval closes.

en.name: Palace of Holyroodhouse
en.text: The official residence of the British monarch in Scotland, this 16th-century palace sits at the foot of the historic Royal Mile.

en.name: St Giles' Cathedral
en.text: Founded in the 12th century, this church is the spiritual heart of Edinburgh, famous for its distinct crown steeple on the city skyline.

en.name: Arthur's Seat
en.text: An ancient dormant volcano in Holyrood Park that rises 251 meters, offering panoramic views of the entire city and the Firth of Forth.

en.name: National Museum of Scotland
en.text: The museum displays vast collections of Scottish history, nature, and science within a stunning Victorian and modern architectural complex.

en.name: Scott Monument
en.text: A 61-meter high Victorian Gothic tower dedicated to author Sir Walter Scott, dominating the skyline in Princes Street Gardens.

en.name: Calton Hill
en.text: A central hill home to several national monuments, including the National Monument and the Nelson Monument, offering iconic city views.

en.name: Princes Street Gardens
en.text: These public gardens separate the Old Town from the New Town, providing a lush green space with direct views of the castle cliff.

en.name: Royal Yacht Britannia
en.text: The former yacht of Queen Elizabeth II, now permanently berthed in Leith as a museum showcasing the life of the Royal Family at sea.

en.name: Talbot Rice Gallery
en.text: The contemporary art gallery of the University of Edinburgh.

en.name: Writers' Museum
en.text: A museum dedicated to the lives and works of famous Scottish writers, including Robert Burns and Walter Scott.

en.name: Dynamic Earth
en.text: A science centre and museum in Edinburgh that offers interactive exhibits on the history and geological formation of Earth.

en.name: National War Museum
en.text: A museum located within Edinburgh Castle showcasing Scotland's military history from the 17th century to the present.

en.name: The King's Gallery
en.text: An art gallery at the Palace of Holyroodhouse that displays works from the Royal Collection.

en.name: St Cecilia's Hall
en.text: A historic concert hall and museum in Edinburgh that houses one of the world's most important collections of musical instruments.

en.name: The People's Story Museum
en.text: A museum in Edinburgh that tells the story of the city's working-class people from the late 18th century to the present day.

en.name: Trinity House
en.text: A historic maritime museum in Leith, once the headquarters of the Trinity House of Leith.

en.name: Royal Scottish Academy
en.text: A prestigious art institution and gallery in Edinburgh promoting contemporary Scottish art and architecture.

en.name: Modern Two
en.text: A branch of the Scottish National Gallery of Modern Art, featuring world-class exhibitions of modern and contemporary art.

en.name: RBGE Inverleith House
en.text: A historic house and contemporary art gallery located within the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh.

en.name: Fruitmarket
en.text: A contemporary art gallery in central Edinburgh known for its innovative exhibitions and commitment to new art.

en.name: Scottish National Portrait Gallery
en.text: A gallery in Edinburgh dedicated to portraits of individuals who have shaped Scottish history and culture.

en.name: Melville's Monument
en.text: A large column monument in St Andrew Square dedicated to Henry Dundas, 1st Viscount Melville.

en.name: St Bernard's Well
en.text: A decorative mineral water well and neoclassical temple located on the banks of the Water of Leith.

en.name: Traverse Theatre
en.text: A renowned theatre in Edinburgh focusing on new writing and contemporary performance.

en.name: Leith Theatre
en.text: A historic performing arts venue in Leith that hosts a variety of concerts, theatre, and community events.

en.name: Pleasance Theatre
en.text: A popular theatre and major hub for the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, offering a wide range of performances.

en.name: Reid Concert Hall
en.text: A concert hall at the University of Edinburgh also housing a significant collection of historic musical instruments.

en.name: Gordon Aikman Lecture Theatre
en.text: A large lecture theatre and multi-purpose venue used for academic lectures and cultural events in Edinburgh.

en.name: Festival Theatre
en.text: A major performing arts venue in Edinburgh hosting opera, ballet, and large-scale theatre productions.

en.name: King's Theatre
en.text: A historic Edwardian theatre in Edinburgh known for its traditional variety shows and pantomimes.

en.name: The Hub
en.text: A landmark gothic building serving as a central hub for the Edinburgh International Festival and other events.

en.name: Assembly Rooms
en.text: A set of historic assembly rooms in Edinburgh's New Town, now used as a multi-purpose event venue.

en.name: Duddingston Kirk
en.text: An ancient parish church in Duddingston village, with parts dating back to the 12th century.

en.name: Edinburgh Central Mosque
en.text: The main mosque of Edinburgh, serving the city's Muslim community with facilities for worship and education.

en.name: Augustine United Church
en.text: A prominent United Reformed Church in central Edinburgh, known for its neo-gothic architecture.

en.name: Charlotte Chapel
en.text: An evangelical Baptist church located in Edinburgh's West End, serving a large local congregation.

en.name: Mayfield Salisbury Parish Church
en.text: A combined parish church in Edinburgh featuring notable architecture and active community involvement.

en.name: Orthodox Community of St Andrew
en.text: An Eastern Orthodox church community in Edinburgh meeting in a historic local church building.

en.name: The Edinburgh Hebrew Congregation
en.text: The main synagogue for the Orthodox Jewish community in Edinburgh, located in the south of the city.

en.name: Wentworth Elm
en.text: A rare surviving elm tree in Edinburgh, considered a notable natural landmark in the Holyrood area.

en.name: Church of St John the Evangelist
en.text: A prominent Scottish Episcopal church at the west end of Princes Street, known for its gothic revival architecture.

en.name: The Parish Church of St Cuthbert
en.text: A historic parish church located at the foot of Edinburgh Castle, standing on one of the city's oldest religious sites.

en.name: New Town Church
en.text: A parish church in the New Town of Edinburgh, serving the local community in a historic building.

en.name: Georgian House
en.text: A restored 18th-century townhouse in Edinburgh's Charlotte Square, showcasing the lifestyle of the Georgian era.

en.name: Castle Rock
en.text: The volcanic plug upon which Edinburgh Castle stands, forming a dramatic part of the city's topography.

en.name: Bruntsfield Links
en.text: An open parkland area in Edinburgh popular for recreation and home to one of the world's oldest golf courses.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Edinburgh ist seit 1437 die Hauptstadt von Schottland und liegt am südlichen Ufer des Firth of Forth. Die Geografie der Stadt ist durch vergangene vulkanische Aktivitäten geprägt, wobei das markante Edinburgh Castle auf dem Castle Rock, einem erloschenen Vulkan, thront. Das historische Zentrum der Stadt teilt sich in die mittelalterliche Old Town mit ihren engen Gassen und der Royal Mile sowie die klassizistische New Town aus dem 18. Jahrhundert auf. Beide Stadtteile wurden im Jahr 1995 aufgrund ihrer außergewöhnlichen architektonischen und historischen Bedeutung zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe erklärt. Als Sitz des schottischen Parlaments und offizielle Residenz des britischen Monarchen im Palace of Holyroodhouse fungiert die Stadt als wichtiges politisches und administratives Zentrum. Während der schottischen Aufklärung war Edinburgh ein führender Ort für intellektuelle Fortschritte in Philosophie und Wissenschaft. Heute ist die Stadt weltweit für das Edinburgh Festival bekannt, eine Reihe von Kunst- und Kulturveranstaltungen, die jährlich im August Millionen von Besuchern anziehen. Die lokale Wirtschaft stützt sich heute vorwiegend auf Finanzdienstleistungen, Hochschulbildung und einen wachsenden Technologiesektor. Edinburghs Festival und Fringe im August 2024 zogen Rekordbesucher an, trotz anhaltender Debatten um Kurzzeitvermietungen und einer 2024 vom Stadtrat beschlossenen neuen Touristenabgabe. Die Pläne zur Fußgängerzone Royal Mile bleiben umstritten.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Edinburgh 1437 óta Skócia fővárosa, a Firth of Forth déli partján helyezkedik el. A város földrajzát meghatározza a korábbi vulkanikus tevékenység, hiszen az ikonikus edinburgh-i vár a Castle Rock nevű kialudt vulkán tetején magasodik. A történelmi központ két fő részre oszlik: a középkori óvárosra (Old Town) a szűk utcáival és a Royal Mile-lal, valamint a 18. században épült neoklasszicista újvárosra (New Town). Mindkét területet 1995-ben az UNESCO Világörökség részévé nyilvánították építészeti és történelmi jelentőségük miatt. Edinburgh a skót parlament székhelye és a brit uralkodó hivatalos skóciai rezidenciája, a Holyroodhouse-palota helyszíne. A skót felvilágosodás idején a város a filozófiai és tudományos haladás egyik legfontosabb központja volt Európában. Napjainkban a város világszerte ismert az Edinburgh-i Fesztiválról, amely egy augusztusban megrendezett művészeti eseménysorozat. Gazdasága jelentős mértékben támaszkodik a pénzügyi szolgáltatásokra, a felsőoktatásra és a turizmusra, miközben modern technológiai központtá is vált. Az edinburgh-i 2024. augusztusi Fesztivál és Fringe rekord közönséget vonzott, miközben folytatódott a vita a rövid távú bérletekről és a tanács által 2024-ben elfogadott új turistadíjról. A Royal Mile sétálóutcássá tételét megosztja a közvélemény.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Edinburgh este capitala Scoției din anul 1437 și este situată pe malul sudic al estuarului Firth of Forth. Geografia orașului este marcată de activitatea vulcanică antică, Castelul Edinburgh fiind situat pe Castle Rock, un vulcan stins care domină peisajul urban. Centrul istoric este divizat între Orașul Vechi medieval, cu străzile sale înguste și faimoasa Royal Mile, și Orașul Nou neoclasic, construit în secolul al XVIII-lea. Ambele zone au fost incluse în patrimoniul mondial UNESCO în anul 1995 datorită valorii lor arhitecturale și istorice excepționale. Ca sediu al Parlamentului Scoțian și reședință oficială a monarhului la Palatul Holyroodhouse, orașul reprezintă un centru politic și administrativ major. În perioada Iluminismului Scoțian, Edinburgh a fost un faimos centru al progresului intelectual în filozofie și știință. Astăzi, orașul este recunoscut la nivel mondial pentru Festivalul de la Edinburgh, o serie de evenimente artistice care atrag anual milioane de vizitatori în luna august. Economia sa modernă se bazează pe servicii financiare, educație superioară și un sector tehnologic în plină dezvoltare. Festivalul și Fringe-ul de la Edinburgh din august 2024 au atras un public record, în pofida dezbaterilor privind închirierile pe termen scurt și a noii taxe turistice aprobate de consiliu în 2024. Pietonalizarea străzii Royal Mile rămâne un subiect controversat.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Edinburgh, the capital city of Scotland since 1437, is situated on the southern shore of the Firth of Forth. The city's geography is defined by ancient volcanic activity, with the iconic Edinburgh Castle perched atop Castle Rock, an extinct volcano that dominates the skyline. The historic center is divided between the medieval Old Town, featuring narrow wynds and the Royal Mile, and the neoclassical New Town, constructed in the 18th century. Both areas were designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1995 for their immense architectural and historical significance. As the seat of the Scottish Parliament and the official residence of the monarch at the Palace of Holyroodhouse, Edinburgh serves as a vital political and administrative hub. During the Scottish Enlightenment, the city was a primary center for intellectual progress in philosophy, economics, and science. Today, it is globally recognized for the Edinburgh Festival, a collection of arts and cultural events held annually in August. The city's economy is highly diversified, with major sectors in financial services, higher education, and tourism. Edinburgh's August 2024 Festival and Fringe drew record audiences despite ongoing debates over short-term lets and a new visitor levy approved by the council in 2024. Royal Mile pedestrianisation proposals continue to divide opinion.

de: Edinburgh ist seit dem Jahr 1437 die offizielle Hauptstadt von Schottland.
Die Old Town und New Town sind seit 1995 Teil des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes.
Das Edinburgh Castle steht auf einem 350 Millionen Jahre alten erloschenen Vulkan.
Die Universität von Edinburgh wurde im Jahr 1582 gegründet.
Die Stadt beherbergt mit dem Fringe das größte Kunstfestival der Welt.
Der Palace of Holyroodhouse ist die offizielle Residenz des britischen Monarchen in Schottland.

Az óváros és az újváros 1995 óta az UNESCO Világörökség része.
Az edinburgh-i vár egy 350 millió éves kialudt vulkánon, a Castle Rockon áll.
Itt rendezik meg a világ legnagyobb művészeti fesztiválját, az Edinburgh Fringe-et.

Orașul Vechi și Orașul Nou sunt incluse în patrimoniul UNESCO din 1995.
Castelul Edinburgh este construit pe un vulcan stins vechi de 350 de milioane de ani.

Orașul găzduiește cel mai mare festival de artă din lume, Edinburgh Fringe.

en: Edinburgh has been the official capital of Scotland since 1437.
The Old Town and New Town have been UNESCO World Heritage sites since 1995.
Edinburgh Castle is built upon an extinct volcano that is 350 million years old.
The University of Edinburgh was founded in the year 1582.
The city hosts the Edinburgh Fringe, the largest arts festival in the world.
The Palace of Holyroodhouse is the official residence of the British monarch in Scotland.
